title: Orchestrator traces requirements through system design
requirement: Для нетривиального бизнес-запроса root-оркестратор должен до декомпозиции связать бизнес-результат, процесс, требования, глобальную архитектуру, системные контракты, задачи и последующие доказательства. Изменение требования должно запускать impact analysis, а не просто создавать ещё одну задачу.
steps: Run `node scripts/analysis-before-decomposition-proof.mjs` against the pre-round-4 scratch (the four fixes reverted): exit 1 (89/93; fresh attach, deferred status, trace mapping and draft trace removal fail).
Create a ready Analysis Record with businessOutcome separate from requestedSolution, process, BR/FR/NFR, architecture/data ownership, contract impact and a trace row per requirement.
Delegate L1/L2: analysis_required/stale; a read-only preset and explicit legacyAttach:true are exempt; a fresh attach without the flag and a write preset behind a role label are gated.

Change process/status/mapping/trace links on ready and draft records: impact/reopen or refusal. Trace mapping is in the semantic fingerprint; deferred/rejected status is a semantic change; a linked task cannot be erased at any status.

Close traced tasks: non-last closes, last is refused, a fully proven batch closes, a mixed batch is refused atomically, malformed records fail closed. A real second-server chat closed a proven task successfully.
Complete one proven and one explicitly deferred requirement; goal completion is refused until the linked record is completed.
expected: 93/93 checks pass and exit 0. L1/L2 are refused analysis_required without a ready record and analysis_stale after an affected change; read-only PRESETS and explicit legacyAttach:true are exempt; process/architecture/contract edits, requirement add/remove, deferred/rejected status changes, trace mapping changes, bare designRef bumps, trace-task unlinks and goalId unlinks all create impacts or refuse; hand edits need acceptHandEdit; the last outstanding task cannot close while planned (non-last can, a fully-proven batch closes); malformed records fail closed; linkTask honours expectedRev. A real second server observed both task_close denial and the allowed task_close after proof.

snapshot.expected: 45/45 checks pass and exit 0. Before a ready record an L1 delegation is refused analysis_required with no task row; an affected mid-work change makes it analysis_stale; a new chat reads the same record and trace; completion separates proven from explicitly deferred and refuses an unresolved requirement.
steps: Run `node scripts/analysis-before-decomposition-proof.mjs` against the tree without the analysis plugin: it exits 1 (red).

Create a ready Analysis Record with analysis_upsert: businessOutcome separate from requestedSolution, process, BR/FR/NFR with acceptance, architecture/data ownership, contract impact, invariants, decisions and a trace row per requirement.

Delegate an L1 task with no record: refused analysis_required, no task row and no child. Delegate again with analysisId + requirementIds: a child starts and the task id is appended to the requirement's trace.

Call analysis_impact after a requirement change: the record reopens as draft with a pending impact and the next delegation is refused analysis_stale; resolve with analysis_upsert(resolveImpacts) and re-check to delegate again.
Start a fresh harness over the same directory (new chat/restart) and read the record: same rev and the same traced task.

Try status completed while a requirement is still planned: completion_blocked. Mark one requirement proven with task+evidence and one explicitly deferred with a reason: the record completes and reports 1 proven / 1 deferred.

history.notes: Fix iteration after independent review. Red run observed on the pre-fix tree (52/67, 15 failures reproducing REVIEWER blockers and CRITIC P1-P5); green run on the fixed plugin + orchestrator. The proof grew from 67 to 70 checks when two acknowledgement checks were added after the restructure. Real store, real delegate_task, real taskboard; no model call or real child.

Fix iteration after independent review; goal guard reads the installed goal tool's real `action:"complete"` field (verified in docs/tool-catalog.md), not a guessed `status`. Red on the pre-fix tree 52/67 exit 1; green 70/70 exit 0. Repacked as @cc/dsh-analysis 0.1.2.

steps: Run `node scripts/analysis-before-decomposition-proof.mjs` against the tree without the analysis plugin or its fixes: it exits 1 (52/67 on the current tree).

Create a ready Analysis Record with analysis_upsert: businessOutcome separate from requestedSolution, process, BR/FR/NFR with acceptance, architecture/data ownership, contract impact and a trace row per requirement.

Delegate L1/L2 with and without analysisId: analysis_required before a ready record, child + traced task id after it, no task row and no child on refusal. A read-only RESEARCH/REVIEWER/CRITIC delegation and a legacy taskId attach with no changeClass start without a record.

Call analysis_impact after a requirement change: the record reopens as draft with a pending impact and delegation is refused analysis_stale; resolve with analysis_upsert and re-check to delegate again.

Attempt task_close on a task traced to a planned requirement: refused; prove the requirement with task evidence then close succeeds. Attempt update_goal complete while a record with that goalId is ready: refused.

Add, remove, and architecture/contract-edit requirements on ready records: each records a pending impact and reopens; removing a requirement that still has a traced task is refused requirement_has_tasks. A bare designRef bump reopens rather than clearing drift.

Start a fresh harness over the same directory (new chat/restart) and read the record: same rev and traced task. Complete one requirement proven and one explicitly deferred; completion reports 1 proven / 1 deferred.

snapshot.expected: 87/87 checks pass and exit 0. L1/L2 are refused analysis_required without a ready record and analysis_stale after an affected change; read-only PRESETS (not forged role labels) and a taskId attach to a pre-existing task are exempt; a process/architecture/contract edit, requirement add/remove, bare designRef bump or trace-only task unlink reopens or refuses the record; a hand edit is refused until acceptHandEdit; the last outstanding task cannot close while its requirement is planned (a non-last task can, and a fully-proven batch closes); malformed records fail closed; goalId is a commitment and goal completion is refused until the linked record is completed; linkTask honours expectedRev.
steps: Run `node scripts/analysis-before-decomposition-proof.mjs` against the pre-fix tree: exit 1 (74/85 at the time; the proof grew to 87 when the batch checks were added).
Create a ready Analysis Record with businessOutcome separate from requestedSolution, process, BR/FR/NFR, architecture/data ownership, contract impact and a trace row per requirement.

Delegate L1/L2 with and without analysisId: analysis_required/analysis_stale; a read-only preset is exempt but a write preset behind a README role label is gated; a taskId attach is exempt only for a task predating the contour.

Change requirement, process, architecture, designRef, trace task link or goalId on a ready record: impact/reopen or refusal (requirement_has_tasks, trace_task_removal, goal_link_locked); hand edit is fingerprint_mismatch until acceptHandEdit.

Close traced tasks: a non-last task on a planned requirement closes, the last is refused; a fully proven batch closes, a mixed batch is refused atomically with both tasks left in review; a malformed record fails closed.
Complete one requirement proven and one explicitly deferred; completion reports 1 proven / 1 deferred. Goal completion is refused until the linked record is completed.

history.notes: Round-4 fixes: trace mapping in the semantic fingerprint/impact, deferred/rejected status as a semantic change, trace-task removal refused at any status, explicit legacyAttach:true instead of timestamp inference. Red is a scratch copy with those four fixes reverted (89/93). Green 93/93 on @cc/dsh-analysis 0.1.4 / @cc/dsh-orchestrator 0.1.43. A real second server additionally observed the positive task_close path: analysis_upsert rev2 ready with proven requirement + evidence, task_close ok:true status done.
